svg.title: Three LEDs on GP15, GP14 and GP13 and a button on GP16, on a half breadboard
svg.desc: A 30-row half breadboard with a Pico 2 W across the center channel in rows 1 to 20, USB end at row 1. A jumper runs from row 3 column j, beside GND at pin 38, to the minus rail. GP15 at pin 20: resistor from row 20 column a to row 30 column a, LED long leg in row 30 column d, short leg in row 30 column f, jumper from row 30 column j to the minus rail. GP14 at pin 19: resistor from row 19 column b to row 26 column b, LED long leg in row 26 column d, short leg in row 26 column f, jumper from row 26 column j to the minus rail. GP13 at pin 17: resistor from row 17 column a to row 28 column a, LED long leg in row 28 column d, short leg in row 28 column f, jumper from row 28 column j to the minus rail. A push button across the channel, its body covering rows 21 to 25, with its legs in rows 22 and 24, columns e and f. GP16 at pin 21, row 20 on the j side: jumper from row 20 column i to row 22 column i. Jumper from row 24 column j to the minus rail.
svg.text: Pico in rows 1 to 20, USB end at row 1
Jumper: row 3 j (GND) to the − rail
GP15: resistor 20 a to 30 a, LED long leg 30 d, short leg 30 f, jumper 30 j to −
GP14: resistor 19 b to 26 b, LED long leg 26 d, short leg 26 f, jumper 26 j to −
GP13: resistor 17 a to 28 a, LED long leg 28 d, short leg 28 f, jumper 28 j to −
Button across the channel: legs in rows 22 and 24, columns e and f
GP16: jumper 20 i to 22 i. Jumper 24 j to −
